question: Who appoints judges of the Supreme Court of Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालको सर्वोच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीश कसले नियुक्त गर्छ?
options: The President, on the recommendation of the Judicial Council
explanation: Supreme Court judges are appointed by the President on the recommendation of the Judicial Council.
explanation_ne: सर्वोच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीश राष्ट्रपतिले न्याय परिषद्को सिफारिसमा नियुक्त गर्छन्।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: What is the retirement age of a Supreme Court judge in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा सर्वोच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीशको अवकाश उमेर कति हो?
explanation: A Supreme Court judge retires at 65 years of age.
explanation_ne: सर्वोच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीश ६५ वर्षको उमेरमा अवकाश पाउँछन्।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: Which writ is issued to produce a person illegally detained before a court?
question_ne: गैरकानुनी रूपमा थुनिएको व्यक्तिलाई अदालतसमक्ष उपस्थित गराउन कुन रिट जारी हुन्छ?
explanation: Habeas corpus (Bandi Pratyakshikaran) orders the production of a person detained unlawfully.
explanation_ne: बन्दी प्रत्यक्षीकरणले गैरकानुनी रूपमा थुनिएको व्यक्तिलाई उपस्थित गराउन आदेश दिन्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: Which writ orders a public authority to perform its legal duty?
question_ne: सार्वजनिक अधिकारीलाई कानुनी कर्तव्य पूरा गर्न आदेश दिने रिट कुन हो?
explanation: Mandamus (Paramadesh) commands a public authority to perform a duty it is legally bound to perform.
explanation_ne: परमादेशले सार्वजनिक अधिकारीलाई कानुनले बाँधिएको कर्तव्य पूरा गर्न आदेश दिन्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: Which writ is issued to quash the decision of a lower court or tribunal?
question_ne: तल्लो अदालत वा न्यायाधिकरणको निर्णय बदर गर्न कुन रिट जारी हुन्छ?
explanation: Certiorari (Utpreshan) quashes a decision of a lower court or tribunal made without jurisdiction or in excess of it.
explanation_ne: उत्प्रेषणले क्षेत्राधिकारबिना वा त्यसभन्दा बढी गरी गरिएको तल्लो अदालत वा न्यायाधिकरणको निर्णय बदर गर्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: Which writ prevents a lower court from proceeding in excess of its jurisdiction?
question_ne: तल्लो अदालतलाई क्षेत्राधिकारभन्दा बढी कारबाही गर्न रोक्ने रिट कुन हो?
explanation: Prohibition (Nishedhagya) prevents a lower court or tribunal from acting beyond its jurisdiction.
explanation_ne: निषेधाज्ञाले तल्लो अदालत वा न्यायाधिकरणलाई क्षेत्राधिकारभन्दा बाहिर काम गर्न रोक्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: Which writ questions by what authority a person holds a public office?
question_ne: कुन अधिकारले व्यक्ति सार्वजनिक पद धारण गरेको छ भनी प्रश्न गर्ने रिट कुन हो?
explanation: Quo warranto (Adhikar Prichchha) asks by what authority a person holds a public office.
explanation_ne: अधिकार पृच्छाले कुन अधिकारले व्यक्ति सार्वजनिक पद धारण गरेको छ भनी प्रश्न गर्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: How many writs can the Supreme Court of Nepal issue under Article 133?
question_ne: धारा १३३ अनुसार नेपालको सर्वोच्च अदालतले कति रिट जारी गर्न सक्छ?
explanation: Under Article 133, the Supreme Court can issue five writs: habeas corpus, mandamus, certiorari, prohibition and quo warranto.
explanation_ne: धारा १३३ अनुसार सर्वोच्च अदालतले पाँच रिट जारी गर्न सक्छ: बन्दी प्रत्यक्षीकरण, परमादेश, उत्प्रेषण, निषेधाज्ञा र अधिकार पृच्छा।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: The Muluki Civil Code, 2074 came into force on which date?
question_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ कहिले लागू भयो?
explanation: The Muluki Civil Code, 2074 and the Muluki Criminal Code, 2074 both came into force on 17 August 2018 (Bhadra 1, 2075).
explanation_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ र मुलुकी अपराध संहिता, २०७४ दुवै १७ अगस्ट २०१८ (भदौ १, २०७५) मा लागू भए।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: The Muluki Criminal Code, 2074 came into force on which date?
question_ne: मुलुकी अपराध संहिता, २०७४ कहिले लागू भयो?
explanation: The Muluki Criminal Code, 2074 came into force on 17 August 2018 (Bhadra 1, 2075), replacing the Muluki Ain, 2020.
explanation_ne: मुलुकी अपराध संहिता, २०७४ १७ अगस्ट २०१८ (भदौ १, २०७५) मा लागू भई मुलुकी ऐन, २०२० लाई प्रतिस्थापन गर्‍यो।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: Which code replaced the Muluki Ain, 2020 in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा मुलुकी ऐन, २०२० लाई कुन संहिताले प्रतिस्थापन गर्‍यो?
options: Muluki Civil Code, 2074 and Muluki Criminal Code, 2074
options_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ र मुलुकी अपराध संहिता, २०७४
explanation: The Muluki Civil Code, 2074 and Muluki Criminal Code, 2074 replaced the Muluki Ain, 2020 on 17 August 2018.

source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: What is the legal age of majority in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा वयस्कताको कानुनी उमेर कति हो?
explanation: A person attains majority at 18 years of age in Nepal.
explanation_ne: नेपालमा व्यक्ति १८ वर्षको उमेरमा वयस्क हुन्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: What is the minimum legal age of marriage in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा विवाहको न्यूनतम कानुनी उमेर कति हो?
explanation: The minimum legal age of marriage in Nepal is 20 years for both men and women.
explanation_ne: नेपालमा विवाहको न्यूनतम कानुनी उमेर पुरुष र महिला दुवैका लागि २० वर्ष हो।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: Child marriage in Nepal is punishable under which law?
question_ne: नेपालमा बाल विवाह कुन कानुनअन्तर्गत दण्डनीय छ?
explanation: Child marriage is an offence under the Muluki Criminal Code, 2074, punishable with imprisonment and a fine.
explanation_ne: बाल विवाह मुलुकी अपराध संहिता, २०७४ अन्तर्गत अपराध हो, कैद र जरिवानाले दण्डनीय छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: Which Act governs the legal profession and advocate licensing in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा कानुनी पेशा र अधिवक्ता लाइसेन्स कुन ऐनले नियमन गर्छ?
explanation: The Nepal Bar Council Act, 2050 (1993) governs the legal profession and the advocate licensing examination.
explanation_ne: नेपाल बार काउन्सिल ऐन, २०५० (सन् १९९३) ले कानुनी पेशा र अधिवक्ता लाइसेन्स परीक्षा नियमन गर्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: The Nepal Bar Council advocate licence examination Paper 1 has how many MCQs?
question_ne: नेपाल बार काउन्सिल अधिवक्ता लाइसेन्स परीक्षाको पेपर १ मा कति बहुविकल्पीय प्रश्न छन्?
explanation: Bar Council Paper 1 (Constitution and Law) has 100 MCQs, 100 marks, 90 minutes, pass 50, with no negative marking.
explanation_ne: बार काउन्सिल पेपर १ (संविधान र कानुन) मा १०० बहुविकल्पीय प्रश्न, १०० अङ्क, ९० मिनेट, उत्तीर्ण ५० हुन्छ, नकारात्मक अङ्कन हुँदैन।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: What is the pass mark for Nepal Bar Council Paper 1?
question_ne: नेपाल बार काउन्सिल पेपर १ को उत्तीर्ण अङ्क कति हो?
explanation: The pass mark for Bar Council Paper 1 is 50 out of 100.
explanation_ne: बार काउन्सिल पेपर १ को उत्तीर्ण अङ्क १०० मा ५० हो।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: After passing the Bar Council written examinations, an advocate candidate must complete what before enrolment?
question_ne: बार काउन्सिल लिखित परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण गरेपछि अधिवक्ता उम्मेदवारले दर्ताअघि के पूरा गर्नुपर्छ?
explanation: After the written papers and interview, candidates complete a supervised internship and training before enrolment as an advocate.
explanation_ne: लिखित पेपर र अन्तर्वार्तापछि उम्मेदवारले अधिवक्ताका रूपमा दर्ताअघि पर्यवेक्षणमा इन्टर्नसिप र तालिम पूरा गर्छन्।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: Which body conducts the advocate licensing examination in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा अधिवक्ता लाइसेन्स परीक्षा कुन निकायले सञ्चालन गर्छ?
explanation: The Nepal Bar Council conducts the advocate licensing examination.
explanation_ne: नेपाल बार काउन्सिलले अधिवक्ता लाइसेन्स परीक्षा सञ्चालन गर्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: In Nepal, a person accused of a crime is presumed what until proven guilty?
question_ne: नेपालमा अपराधको आरोप लागेको व्यक्ति दोषी प्रमाणित नभएसम्म के मानिन्छ?
explanation: Under the right to justice (Article 20), a person accused of an offence is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
explanation_ne: न्याय सम्बन्धी हक (धारा २०) अनुसार अपराधको आरोप लागेको व्यक्ति दोषी प्रमाणित नभएसम्म निर्दोष मानिन्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: No person shall be punished for an act that was not an offence when committed. This principle is called what?
question_ne: गरिएको बेला अपराध नभएको कार्यका लागि कसैलाई सजाय दिनु हुँदैन। यो सिद्धान्तलाई के भनिन्छ?
options: Prohibition of ex post facto law
explanation: The Constitution prohibits ex post facto punishment: no one may be punished for an act that was not an offence when it was done.
explanation_ne: संविधानले भूतलक्षी सजाय निषेध गर्छ: गरिएको बेला अपराध नभएको कार्यका लागि कसैलाई सजाय दिनु हुँदैन।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: No person shall be tried twice for the same offence. This principle is called what?
question_ne: एउटै अपराधका लागि कसैलाई दुई पटक मुद्दा चलाउनु हुँदैन। यो सिद्धान्तलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Double jeopardy prohibits a person from being prosecuted or punished twice for the same offence.
explanation_ne: दोहोरो जोखिमले एउटै अपराधका लागि व्यक्तिलाई दुई पटक अभियोजन वा सजाय गर्न निषेध गर्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: Which constitutional body investigates corruption in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा भ्रष्टाचारको अनुसन्धान गर्ने संवैधानिक निकाय कुन हो?
options: Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority (CIAA)
explanation: The Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority (CIAA) investigates corruption by public officials.
explanation_ne: अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोगले सार्वजनिक अधिकारीको भ्रष्टाचारको अनुसन्धान गर्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: Which constitutional body recruits civil servants in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा निजामती कर्मचारी भर्ना गर्ने संवैधानिक निकाय कुन हो?
explanation: The Public Service Commission (Lok Sewa Aayog) recruits civil servants through competitive examinations.
explanation_ne: लोक सेवा आयोगले प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक परीक्षामार्फत निजामती कर्मचारी भर्ना गर्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: Which constitutional body audits government accounts in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा सरकारी लेखा परीक्षण गर्ने संवैधानिक निकाय कुन हो?
explanation: The Auditor General audits the accounts of the government and public bodies.
explanation_ne: महालेखा परीक्षकले सरकार र सार्वजनिक निकायका लेखा परीक्षण गर्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: The Attorney General of Nepal is appointed by whom?
question_ne: नेपालको महान्यायाधिवक्ता कसले नियुक्त गर्छ?
options: The President, on the recommendation of the Prime Minister
explanation: The Attorney General is appointed by the President on the recommendation of the Prime Minister.
explanation_ne: महान्यायाधिवक्ता राष्ट्रपतिले प्रधानमन्त्रीको सिफारिसमा नियुक्त गर्छन्।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: Which Act governs evidence in Nepali courts?
question_ne: नेपाली अदालतमा प्रमाण कुन ऐनले नियमन गर्छ?
explanation: The Evidence Act, 2031 (1974) governs the law of evidence in Nepali courts.
explanation_ne: प्रमाण ऐन, २०३१ (सन् १९७४) ले नेपाली अदालतमा प्रमाणको कानुन नियमन गर्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: The burden of proof in a criminal case lies on whom?
question_ne: फौजदारी मुद्दामा प्रमाणको भार कसमा हुन्छ?
explanation: In a criminal case the prosecution must prove the accused's guilt beyond reasonable doubt.
explanation_ne: फौजदारी मुद्दामा अभियोजन पक्षले प्रतिवादीको दोष शङ्कारहित रूपमा प्रमाणित गर्नुपर्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: A contract made by a minor in Nepal is generally what?
question_ne: नेपालमा नाबालकले गरेको करार सामान्यतया के हुन्छ?
explanation: A contract with a minor is generally void in Nepal, as a minor lacks capacity to contract.
explanation_ne: नेपालमा नाबालकसँगको करार सामान्यतया शून्य हुन्छ, किनभने नाबालकमा करार गर्ने क्षमता हुँदैन।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: For a valid contract in Nepal, which element is essential?
question_ne: नेपालमा मान्य करारका लागि कुन तत्त्व आवश्यक छ?
explanation: A valid contract requires offer and acceptance, free consent, lawful consideration and lawful object, and capacity of the parties.
explanation_ne: मान्य करारका लागि प्रस्ताव र स्वीकृति, स्वतन्त्र सहमति, कानुनी प्रतिफल र कानुनी उद्देश्य, र पक्षहरूको क्षमता आवश्यक छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: A contract entered into by coercion is what under Nepali law?
question_ne: जबरजस्ती गरेर गरिएको करार नेपाली कानुनअनुसार के हुन्छ?
options: Voidable at the option of the coerced party
explanation: A contract made by coercion is voidable at the option of the party whose consent was obtained by coercion.
explanation_ne: जबरजस्ती गरेर गरिएको करार पीडित पक्षको विकल्पमा शून्ययोग्य हुन्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: Which law governs local governments in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा स्थानीय सरकार कुन कानुनले नियमन गर्छ?
explanation: The Local Government Operation Act, 2074 governs the operation of rural municipalities and municipalities.
explanation_ne: स्थानीय सरकार सञ्चालन ऐन, २०७४ ले गाउँपालिका र नगरपालिकाको सञ्चालन नियमन गर्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: How many fundamental duties are listed in Article 48 of the Constitution of Nepal 2072?
question_ne: नेपालको संविधान २०७२ को धारा ४८ मा कति मौलिक कर्तव्य सूचीबद्ध छन्?
explanation: Article 48 lists eleven fundamental duties of citizens, including safeguarding national unity and protecting public property.
explanation_ne: धारा ४८ मा नागरिकका एघार मौलिक कर्तव्य सूचीबद्ध छन्, जसमा राष्ट्रिय एकता जोगाउने र सार्वजनिक सम्पत्ति संरक्षण गर्ने पनि पर्छ।
source: Nepal law — Constitution of Nepal 2072, Muluki Codes 2074, Nepal Bar Council

question: Which article of the Constitution deals with the directive principles of state policy?
question_ne: संविधानको कुन धाराले राज्यका निर्देशक सिद्धान्तसँग सम्बन्धित छ?
